phase3_findings.description: The Start<->Stop HANDLE-match contract is untested. The fix moved the self-test marker path off single-source job-wide GITHUB_ENV publication to independent re-derivation of HANDLE="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-0}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-0}-${GITHUB_JOB:-job}" in each step body (Start: devflow-implement.yml:765 / devflow.yml:1243; Stop: :1680 / :1890). installer-wiring.sh AC10 greps only the Stop step's export line literal, not the two HANDLE= definitions being byte-equal; run.sh AC11/AC12 set DEVFLOW_REFRESH_SELFTEST_FAILED explicitly and never exercise workflow HANDLE derivation. The old GITHUB_ENV form made divergence impossible; the new form reintroduces it as a live, untested drift risk. The current literals ARE byte-identical (verified), so no live bug exists today.
phase3_findings.step25_classification: test-hardening-suggestion; NEW consideration introduced by the fix delta; not a current correctness defect

phase3_findings.description: The normalizer-availability guard is a three-clause && chain ([ -r "$_reap_lib" ] && . "$_reap_lib" && command -v devflow_normalize_path). Only the first clause (sibling lib absent) is independently exercised by the nolib copy test; the sourcing-fails and function-undefined clauses fall to the same fail-safe else arm but are not independently hit. Defensive layering; the absent-lib arm already proves the else fires.
phase3_findings.step25_classification: low-value coverage suggestion; behavior fail-closed is already proven

phase3_findings.description: run.sh region-containment comment (~line 148-150) says the setup drops the refresher paths the Start step publishes into $GITHUB_ENV, but the actual unset is a defensive superset that also clears DEVFLOW_REFRESH_SELFTEST_FAILED (no longer published) and DEVFLOW_REFRESH_REAP_GLOB (test-only override). Behavior correct; wording slightly imprecise.

diff_profile.nature: shell fail-closed reap-scope normalization + workflow self-test-marker in-body derivation + tests

report: Iteration-2 review of the fix delta (c8a65de) for PR #1930 / issue #1925. VERDICT: APPROVE. No new correctness defect introduced by the fix. Verified independently: (1) the Stop-step in-body HANDLE derivation is byte-identical to the Start step's, and the marker's sole writer (refresher-selftest.sh, driven with the local STMARK) never read the removed job-wide env var, so retiring the GITHUB_ENV publication orphans no consumer and causes no #1882 mis-attribution; (2) normalize-path.sh is vendored alongside stop-refresher.sh (vendor-slice copies lib/ wholesale, prunes only lib/test) and the dirname/BASH_SOURCE anchor resolves in both vendored and self-repo invocations; it is function-only and side-effect-free to source; (3) all fail-closed arms (drive-letter [A-Za-z]:*, backslash *\*, UNC, forward-slash-drive, drive-relative, normalizer-unsourceable) fail CLOSED (empty glob, ::warning:: breadcrumb, no reap) and normal Linux/macOS RUNNER_TEMP is not falsely refused; (4) assertion-floor bump 287->293 reconciles with the 6 new installer-wiring assertions (AC9/AC10 x2 workflows + 2 positive controls), and tests carry mutant-kill positive/negative controls. Three advisory findings, none blocking: one Important test-hardening gap (the Start<->Stop HANDLE equality became falsifiable by the move off GITHUB_ENV and is not pinned by any assertion -- current literals are byte-equal so no live bug, but a regression guard is worth adding), one Suggestion (guard-chain clauses not independently exercised), one Suggestion (a superset-unset comment wording imprecision). The two findings pushed back in iteration 1 were not re-raised and no new evidence contradicts them.
new_vs_iteration1: No NEW correctness defect. The Important finding (untested Start<->Stop HANDLE equality) is a NEW test-hardening consideration arising specifically from this iteration's fix delta (the move off single-source GITHUB_ENV), not a re-raise of any iteration-1 finding. The two Suggestions are new but behavior-inert.
